summary.text: Steven Doan is a Republican state representative from Kentucky House District 69 who has served since 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is an attorney from Erlanger.

paragraphs.text: Steven Doan earned a bachelor's degree and a juris doctor from Northern Kentucky University in 2009 and 2012, respectively.

In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, he said he is a lifelong resident of Erlanger, Kentucky, and that he has worked in the executive branch under Governor Matt Bevin, as a private attorney, and as an Erlanger City Council member.
Doan took office in the Kentucky House on January 1, 2023, succeeding Adam Koenig.

In the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Committee on Families and Children, the Primary and Secondary Education Committee, the Local Government Committee, and the Postsecondary Education Committee.
In the 2022 survey, he listed reducing taxes, increasing freedom, and cleaning up corruption as the key messages of his campaign.
